results.description: Confirmation of payee before a transfer
results.expected: Registered name returned for a real recipient; 404 for an unknown address; 401 when signed out
results.actual: Known HTTP 200 "payeeb Test", paid before: false; unknown HTTP 404; signed out HTTP 401; after one payment, paid before: true

results.expected: Weak PIN and wrong password refused; valid PIN stored as a bcrypt hash; changing it needs the current PIN
results.actual: Weak PIN HTTP 400; wrong password HTTP 403; valid HTTP 200; change without the current PIN HTTP 403, with it HTTP 200; account reports a PIN: true; bcrypt hash stored: true

results.description: Risk assessment and explanation stored with a transaction
results.expected: Model score, risk score, signals and feature contributions recorded; contributions add up to the model score
results.actual: HTTP 200; model score 0.365; risk 0.46025; signals: new_recipient; 7 contributions; base value plus contributions = 0.3650

results.description: Unusual payment is challenged for the PIN
results.expected: HTTP 428 and no money moved without the PIN or with a wrong PIN; payment completes with the right PIN and no alert is raised
results.actual: No PIN HTTP 428 (pin: First payment to this recipient; Money received in the last 15 minutes is being passed straight on; A similar amount came from this recipient in the last 24 hours); scores kept from the client: true; wrong PIN HTTP 403; balance unchanged: true; right PIN HTTP 200, recorded as verified; alert: none

results.description: Unusual payment by a user with no PIN
results.expected: HTTP 428 asking the user to set a PIN; no money moved
results.actual: HTTP 428 (set_pin) "This payment needs your transaction PIN. Set a PIN under Security, then try again."; balance unchanged: true

results.description: Five wrong PIN attempts lock the PIN
results.expected: Fifth wrong attempt locks the PIN; the right PIN is then refused with HTTP 423
results.actual: Wrong attempts HTTP 403, 403, 403, 403, 403; right PIN afterwards HTTP 423 "Too many wrong PIN attempts. Try again in 15 minutes."

results.description: High-risk payment is held, then released by the analyst
results.expected: Sender debited, recipient not credited and transaction pending; after the alert is cleared the recipient is credited
results.actual: HTTP 200, held: true, risk 0.892610; transaction pending, alert type hold; while held sender 0, recipient 100, hidden from recipient: true; review HTTP 200 (released); transaction completed, recipient now 3100

results.description: High-risk payment is held, then refunded when fraud is confirmed
results.expected: After the alert is confirmed as fraud the money is back with the sender and the recipient received nothing
results.actual: Held: true; review HTTP 200 (reversed); second decision HTTP 409; transaction failed; sender back to 3000; recipient 100

results.description: Signals still protect the wallet when the model score is low
results.expected: A burst of small payments to one recipient is challenged although the model alone scores each below the threshold
results.actual: Payments HTTP 200, 200, 200, 428; highest model score among those sent 0.176667; fourth stopped for: 3 payments out in the last 10 minutes; 3 payments to this recipient in the last 10 minutes

results.expected: Every attack step expected to be caught is caught; ordinary behaviour raises no false alarm; a non-administrator is refused
results.actual: Non-admin HTTP 403; normal: 0 false alarms in 3; takeover: 1 of 1 caught (model alone 1); velocity: 4 of 4 caught (model alone 0); mule_chain: 2 of 2 caught (model alone 0); fan_in: 2 of 2 caught (model alone 1); round_trip: 2 of 2 caught (model alone 1); cleanup removed 20 accounts, 0 left

results.description: Security headers and sign-in rate limit
results.expected: Security headers on responses; the eleventh failed sign-in in 15 minutes is refused with HTTP 429
results.actual: Headers present: content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options; first ten attempts HTTP 401; eleventh HTTP 429

results.description: Held payment cannot be settled twice or by a non-administrator
results.expected: A user cannot review an alert; a reviewed hold does not move money again
results.actual: User review HTTP 403, still held: true; second release HTTP 409; recipient credited once: 3100

results.description: Parallel requests cannot get round the checks
results.expected: Of eight identical transfers sent at once, no more than three go through before the PIN is asked for; eight wrong PINs sent at once lock the PIN
results.actual: Eight at once: 3 sent, 5 asked for the PIN, 900 moved; after eight wrong PINs at once the right PIN gets HTTP 423

results.description: Held payment of a money request
results.expected: The request stays open while the payment is held and is marked paid when the payment is released
results.actual: Held: true; request while held: pending; after release: paid
